description.zh: 应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符。
description.en: The application ID. You can specify only one application ID. The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符。此ID为旁路转推的标识，需保证唯一。
description.en: The task ID. You can specify only one task ID. The ID can be up to 55 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The ID must be unique.

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[StartLiveMPUTask](~~2848199~~)开始混流转推任务。
- 如果需要停止混流转推任务时，此时混流转推任务异常（未调用StopLiveMPUTask停止任务），本次混流转推任务会在最后一个人离开频道2分钟后自动停止任务。停止后如果需要恢复混流转推，您需要重新调用[StartLiveMPUTask](~~2848199~~)接口。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为500次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Make sure that a mixed-stream relay task is started before you call this operation. You can call the [StartLiveMPUTask](~~2848199~~) operation to start a mixed-stream relay task.

- If a mixed-stream relay task becomes abnormal, the task is automatically stopped 2 minutes after the last person leaves the channel. In this case, you do not need to call the StopLiveMPUTask operation. If you need to resume a mixed-stream relay task that is stopped, call the [StartLiveMPUTask](~~2848199~~) operation again.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 500 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live stop-live-mpu-task --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live StopLiveMPUTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId yourTaskId --AppId yourAppId
